say:2:1230152001:1.text: According to Sonja, she came face-to-face with countless Graveborn when she and her men boarded the deck of the Immortal!
say:2:1230152001:1.source_cn: 听当家的说，当时她和手下登上不死号的甲板，遭遇了数不清...

say:3:1230152002:1.text: She weaved her way through various compartments and was even subject to the terrifying gravecalling magic...
say:3:1230152002:1.source_cn: 她带队登舰，在舱室间穿梭，还遇到了可怕的亡灵法术……

say:4:1230152003:1.text: What?! How did Sonja win the battle?
say:4:1230152003:1.source_cn: 什么？！那当家的是怎么赢的？

say:5:1230152004:1.text: I heard it was an outlander mage who gave Sonja a hand. Mages are rare here. I wish we could meet one someday.
say:5:1230152004:1.source_cn: 听说，是从锈锚港外来的魔法师帮了当家一把。魔法师诶，很...
